annotations.title: Insurance: insurers' facts, public ratings and official websites (no prices, no ranking)

description: An information comparison, not a ranking (prices: false, ranking: false, score: null): Fordeal is not an insurance intermediary, sells no insurance, shows no premium and recommends no policy. For a country (CZ for now) it answers the kinds of insurance (motor third-party liability, comprehensive motor, home contents, property, travel, personal liability, accident, life, legal protection, health insurance for foreigners, other) with the four things to compare besides the price, and `cards`: one per insurer with the kinds its public site offers, the products in the insurer's words (products: name, kind, online), the kinds that can be concluded online on the official site (online_kinds; online_unknown_kinds = the site does not say), a nonstop assistance line, a mobile app and an online claim form, each a fact {value: true | false | null, note, source_url, checked_on} where null means the site does not state it (never a no), the IČO from the ČNB register (registry; cross_border: true for an offer without a Czech IČO), the public customer rating (source: Firmy.cz or Google Maps by its link; score, scale, count, source_url, fetched_on; only from 10 reviews, otherwise null = no rating yet), factual tags and the official website (commission: false, affiliate: false, no tracking parameters). Filters: kind, online (online for the asked kind), assistance, app, claim_online (true); filter_counts says how many insurers each option leaves. sort: name (default, alphabetical) | rating (public rating from the highest, insurers without a rating last) | kinds (number of kinds offered). compare = 2–3 insurer ids for `comparison` side by side. Tell the person to read the terms on the insurer's site; the premium and the contract are the insurer's.

app.description: true: only insurers with an official mobile app for clients.

assistance.description: true: only insurers whose site states a nonstop (24/7) assistance line.

claim_online.description: true: only insurers whose site takes a claim report online.

kind.description: Only the insurers of this kind of insurance.

locale.description: Language of the guide URLs (cs | sk | en …, default cs).

online.description: true: only insurers whose official site concludes the asked kind (or any kind) online.

sort.description: name (default) | rating | kinds. Never a recommendation.
